battle.name: 杜伏威起義
battle.brief: 大業九年（613）秋，杜伏威與輔公祏在齊州長白山聚眾起義，隨後轉戰淮南，合併苗海潮、趙破陣兩部。義軍初期不與隋軍主力硬碰，靠山林游擊與火攻破敵，校尉宋顢被引入蘆葦蕩燒死，翌年虎牙郎將公孫上哲鎮壓亦全軍覆沒。卡面希臘重步兵成軍於公元前五世紀，與此役無關，只能與義軍散兵游擊對照。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 此役的交戰雙方，是隋朝的州郡軍政體系與聚於山東、江淮的起義聯軍。隋朝方面，煬帝自大業六年起三征高句麗，府庫、漕運與民力同時見底，江淮一線的防守倚賴各州郡的府兵、縣鄉兵，以及中央遣派的虎牙郎將、虎賁郎將與行軍總管。大業九年，煬帝在涿郡一線籌劃再征高句麗，江都留守府獨力承擔南面的防務，義軍正是從這個方向逼近。起義方面，杜伏威與輔公祏原是章丘一帶的亡命之徒，長白山下聚眾起事之後並無官府編制，只能靠自稱將軍、合併同類武裝壯大，先後收編苗海潮、趙破陣兩支起義隊伍，兵眾由數十百人擴張為數萬之眾。杜伏威在淮南自稱總管，以輔公祏為長史，設軍令、行賞罰，逐步把散兵游勇整頓成能攻能守的軍隊，並以減賦稅、廢殉葬、懲貪污的做法爭取民間支持，使隊伍在隋朝失去地方秩序的地帶站穩腳跟。
countriesEn: The two parties in this campaign were the command system of the Sui prefectures and counties, and the rebel coalition that gathered in Shandong and in the Huai region. On the Sui side, from the sixth year of the Daye era (610) the Yangdi emperor had launched three campaigns against Goguryeo, and the treasury, the canal transport and the manpower of the people were all exhausted together; the defence of the Huai and lower Yangtze line rested on the militia of the prefectures, on the county and village levies, and on the tiger-general officers, tiger-guard officers and campaign commissioners sent down from the centre. In 613 the emperor was at Zhuojun arranging yet another Goguryeo expedition, so the Jiangdu resident office bore the southern defence on its own, and it was precisely from that direction that the rebels closed in. On the rebel side, Du Fuwei and Fu Gongshi were originally fugitives from the Zhangqiu area; after mustering at Changbai Mountain they held no official commission of any kind and could grow only by calling themselves generals and by absorbing armed bands of the same kind, taking in the rebel groups of Miao Haichao and Zhao Pozhen in turn, so that a few hundred men at the start expanded into a force counted in tens of thousands. Du Fuwei then styled himself zongguan in the Huai region, made Fu Gongshi his zhangshi, set out his orders and his rewards and punishments, and gradually turned an unruly mob into an army able to attack and to hold ground; by reducing taxes, abolishing the burial of the living with the dead and punishing corruption he won the support of the people in a region where Sui order had already broken down.
people: 核心人物是杜伏威（583－623），名堯，字伏威，齊州章丘人。少年時慣於偷盜，與輔公祏結為刎頸之交；十六歲那年因盜案案發、官府追捕，兩人落草為寇。大業九年，他與輔公祏逃到長白山一帶，組織山賊率眾起義，隨後轉戰淮南，合併各部，自稱將軍，終在歷陽自稱總管，以輔公祏為長史。他治軍嚴厲而能與將士同甘共苦，每戰將士爭先效死，所獲財物悉數分賞將士，因而所向多捷。隋方關鍵人物包括江都留守府校尉宋顢，奉命出擊卻被杜伏威引入蘆葦蕩，以火攻燒死；虎牙郎將公孫上哲於大業十二年率師鎮壓，兵敗鹽城，全軍覆沒；隋朝名將陳稜於大業十三年被杜伏威擊敗，高郵隨之淪陷。隋煬帝是這一輪鎮壓的最高決策者。大業十四年，杜伏威向東都楊侗稱臣，被封為楚王、東道大總管；武德二年，唐朝實力坐大，杜伏威轉而歸唐，封吳王、賜姓李，與李淵、李世民父子建立新的合作。輔公祏則是杜伏威的副手兼結義兄弟，日後叛唐而亡。
peopleEn: The central figure was Du Fuwei (583-623), personal name Yao, courtesy name Fuwei, a native of Zhangqiu in Qizhou. As a boy he was given to theft and he and Fu Gongshi swore the oath of cutting their throats for each other; when the burglary case broke and the authorities began to pursue them, the two took to the hills as bandits at the age of sixteen. In 613 Du Fuwei and Fu Gongshi fled to the Changbai Mountain region, organised the mountain bandits and led them in revolt, then campaigned into the Huai region, absorbed other bands, called himself general, and finally at Liyang proclaimed himself zongguan with Fu Gongshi as his zhangshi. He governed his army strictly and shared the hardships of his men; in every battle the soldiers strove to give their lives and what was taken was distributed to them, which is why he was rarely checked. The key Sui figures include the Jiangdu clerk Song Hao, sent out to suppress the revolt but lured by Du Fuwei into a reed marsh and burnt alive, and the tiger-general officer Gongsun Shangzhe, who was sent with an army in the seventh month of the twelfth year of Daye (616), was defeated at Yancheng and had his entire force annihilated; the noted Sui commander Chen Leng was beaten by Du Fuwei in 617 and Gaoyou fell with him. The Yangdi emperor was the supreme decision maker behind the suppression. In 618 Du Fuwei submitted to Yang Tong at the eastern capital and was made Prince of Chu and East Circuit Grand Commissioner; in the second year of Wude (619), with the Tang clearly the stronger power, Du Fuwei turned to the Tang, was made Prince of Wu and given the surname Li, and entered into a new partnership with Li Yuan and Li Shimin. Fu Gongshi was Du Fuwei's deputy and sworn brother; he would later rebel against the Tang and die in the attempt.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是公元前五世紀的希臘重步兵（Hoplite），成型於希臘城邦時代的方陣步兵，本戰役中並不存在這樣的裝備，只能作為比較之用：重步兵方陣靠盾牌相接、互相遮蔽取得正面厚度，而杜伏威的義軍恰恰走的是相反的路子，初期沒有成建制的鎧甲與重盾，多是標槍、弓箭與刀，靠山林地形、流動轉進與火攻取得戰果。義軍可用的裝備包括削尖的長矛與標槍、竹木弓與箭、環首刀與短戟、藤或皮製的簡易護具，騎兵極少，馬匹多靠繳獲隋軍的軍馬與徵集得來，起義初期幾乎可以忽略不計。隋軍方面則是另一套體系：鎧甲騎士搭配長槊與弓弩，步卒以長槊、刀和木製大盾成列，攻城則用雲梯、撞車、巢車與擲石機，江都水軍備有樓船與運輸船，糧秣主要沿運河與淮水轉運。雙方真正的差距不在單件兵器，而在訓練、編制與補給。義軍靠嚴格的軍紀、均分的戰利品和就地徵糧維持作戰，隋軍則依靠後方的漕運與州郡徵發，這正是後來義軍能以小眾反覆吃掉隋軍分隊的關鍵。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Greek hoplite, a soldier of the fifth century BC formed in the phalanx infantry of the Greek city-states; nothing of the kind existed in this campaign, so the card can serve only as a comparison. A hoplite phalanx wins frontage by locking shields together so that each man covers the next, and Du Fuwei's rebels walked the opposite road: at the outset they had no formed armour and no heavy shields, but sharpened spears, bows and knives, and they won through terrain, mobility and fire. The rebel equipment consisted of sharpened pikes and javelins, bamboo and wooden bows with arrows, ring-pommel sabres and short halberds, and simple hide or rattan protection; their cavalry was very small, and their horses came mostly from captured Sui remounts and from local levies, a quantity that barely counted in the first years of the revolt. The Sui army worked on a different system: armoured horsemen paired with long lances, bows and crossbows, infantry formed in ranks with lances, sabres and large wooden shields, siege ladders, battering rams, siege towers and stone-throwing engines for the attack on walls, war-junks and transport boats for the Jiangdu flotilla, and grain moved north to south along the canals and the Huai. The real gap between the two sides lay in training, organisation and supply rather than in any single weapon. The rebels kept themselves in the field through strict discipline, an even share of the spoils and grain taken on the spot, while the Sui relied on canal transport and on levies raised by the prefectures, and that distance is the reason Sui detachments marching south could be destroyed again and again by a much smaller force.
tactics: 起義初期，杜伏威放棄守城，選擇據長白山一帶的山林。隋軍的優勢是馬槊與騎兵，義軍的優勢是熟悉道路、能以小隊分散行動，於是形成一套避實擊虛的打法：不與隋軍主力正面硬碰，只打分遣出城的小股部隊，打完即退，轉入另一處。對宋顢的戰役即典型一例，義軍把隋軍引入蘆葦蕩，順風放火，隋軍葬身火海；鹽城之戰則是先以步騎接戰，待隋軍陣形鬆散時全線壓上，把公孫上哲所部全數消滅。義軍的另一個戰術層面是整編：不斷合併苗海潮、趙破陣等部眾，統一號令與賞罰，把不同來源的武裝編為可用之師。行軍紀律上，杜伏威施行減賦稅、廢殉葬、懲治貪污，軍中所獲財物多分賞將士，據記載將士皆為其戰，所向無敵。補給線上，義軍依賴泗水、淮水的水路與沿線鹽利，隋軍則靠運河漕運自北方運糧至江都，兩者的距離決定了隋軍每次出兵都要在淮南停留數月，義軍則可以不戰而遷。
tacticsEn: At first Du Fuwei gave up holding walled towns and chose to base himself in the forests around Changbai Mountain. The Sui advantage was the lance and the mounted arm, while the rebels' advantage was their knowledge of the roads and their ability to move in small bodies, and the pattern that followed was to avoid the Sui main force and strike only at the detachments sent out of the towns, breaking off and withdrawing into another district after each clash. The action against Song Hao is the typical case: the rebels drew the Sui troops into a reed marsh and fired the reeds downwind, and the Sui men were swallowed by the flames; at Yancheng the rebels first engaged with infantry and cavalry, and when the Sui formation loosened they pressed along the whole line and destroyed Gongsun Shangzhe's army to the last man. A second layer of the rebel method was reorganisation: bands such as those of Miao Haichao and Zhao Pozhen were absorbed one after another, the command signal and the system of rewards and punishments were made uniform, and armed groups from different sources were turned into a usable army. On discipline, Du Fuwei reduced taxes, abolished the practice of burying the living with the dead and punished corruption, and what was taken in the field was largely handed to the soldiers, so that the records show the men fighting for him wherever he led. On supply, the rebels lived off the waterways of the Si and Huai rivers and the salt revenues along them, while the Sui drew their grain north to south along the canals to Jiangdu; that distance meant that every Sui army sent south had to sit in the Huai region for months, whereas the rebels could move on without a battle.
data: 可考的時間點與數字如下。大業九年（613）秋，年約三十歲的杜伏威在濟北長白山起義；同年隋煬帝在涿郡部署第三次征高句麗的兵事。大業十二年（616）七月，虎牙郎將公孫上哲所率隋軍在鹽城覆滅，全軍被殲一事見於通鑑，細部數目史無記載。大業十三年（617），杜伏威敗隋將陳稜於淮南，隨即破高郵；同年他在歷陽自稱總管，以輔公祏為長史。大業十四年（618），杜伏威向東都楊侗稱臣，封楚王，拜東道大總管；武德二年（619）歸唐，封吳王、賜姓李；武德三年（620）擊敗李子通，把根據地移到丹陽；武德四年（621）遣兵助唐軍攻洛陽；武德五年（622）七月奉召入朝；武德六年（623）正月拜太子太保，同年八月輔公祏反唐敗死，三月廿七日杜伏威憂懼而卒，虛歲四十一。兵力方面史無確數，起義初期為數十百人，至淮南時傳稱眾至數萬，只能視為量級的參考而非確數。地理上，濟北長白山至淮南六合約八百里，至鹽城約一千二百里，隋軍自洛陽、涿郡調兵南下，沿運河與淮水行軍需數月。
dataEn: The datable points and figures are as follows. In the autumn of the ninth year of Daye (613), Du Fuwei, then about thirty years old, rose in revolt at Changbai Mountain in northern Jizhou; in the same year the Yangdi emperor was at Zhuojun making ready the third expedition against Goguryeo. In the seventh month of the twelfth year of Daye (616) the Sui army led by the tiger-general officer Gongsun Shangzhe was annihilated at Yancheng; the total destruction of that force appears in the Comprehensive Mirror, though the exact figures are not recorded. In the thirteenth year of Daye (617) Du Fuwei defeated the Sui commander Chen Leng in the Huai region and took Gaoyou at once; in the same year he proclaimed himself zongguan at Liyang and made Fu Gongshi his zhangshi. In 618 Du Fuwei submitted to Yang Tong at the eastern capital, was made Prince of Chu and appointed East Circuit Grand Commissioner; in 619 he went over to the Tang, was made Prince of Wu and given the surname Li; in 620 he defeated Li Zitong and moved his base to Danyang; in 621 he sent troops to help the Tang army attack Luoyang; in the seventh month of 622 he was summoned to the capital; in the first month of 623 he was made Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince, in the eighth month of that year Fu Gongshi rebelled against the Tang and was killed, and on the twenty-seventh day of the third month Du Fuwei died of fear and anxiety, being forty-one by East Asian reckoning. As for the size of the force, the sources give no exact figure: a few hundred men at the start, and by the time the rebels reached the Huai region the number is given as tens of thousands, which should be read as an order of magnitude and not a firm count. As to distance, Changbai Mountain in northern Jizhou lies about eight hundred li from Liuhe in the Huai region and about twelve hundred li from Yancheng, and Sui troops moved south from Luoyang and Zhuojun along the canals and the Huai, taking months on the march.
cause: 起義的直接背景，是隋朝在東北方向的大規模消耗。大業六年（610）起兵征高句麗，役後大敗，府庫空虛，民間承受的兵役、徭役與轉輸之重已到極限；其後連年再征，役夫與逃戶被集中編入軍隊，戶籍與里甲之制形同崩壞。皇帝本人又兩度巡遊江都，儀仗與供應全部取自沿運河的州縣，江淮是漕糧的產地，也最先被榨乾。饑荒與水旱災害的消息在大業九年前後密集傳出，山東、河北一帶的流民大批轉為盜匪，杜伏威這樣的亡命者才有追隨者可言。隋廷的反應卻慢：涿郡的軍情與江都的防守相隔數千里，中央每次調兵、每次改派都要等文書往返，地方守將往往在得知起義時已失去先機。加上此前已有王薄、竇建德、孫萬榮、宋子仙等地的響應，隋末天下大亂的局面就此成形，杜伏威起義正是這股洪流中起步最早、也最見成效的一支。
causeEn: The immediate background to the revolt was the enormous drain of the Sui state in the northeast. From 610 the Yangdi emperor raised armies against Goguryeo and after the first defeat the treasury was empty and the military service, corvée and transport burden on the people had reached its limit; further campaigns followed, and levies and runaways were herded into the army until the household registers and the village system existed in name only. The emperor himself twice toured Jiangdu, and the ceremonial escort and the supplies were taken entirely from the prefectures along the canal; the Huai and Yangtze region produced the grain for the transport system and was the first area to be squeezed dry. Reports of famine and of flood and drought grew thick around the years 609 to 613, and the refugees of Shandong and Hebei turned in large numbers into bandits, which is what gave men like Du Fuwei followers to lead. The court's response was slow: news from Zhuojun and the defence of Jiangdu were a thousand li apart, and every redeployment of troops had to wait for documents to travel back and forth, so that local commanders often lost the initiative before they even knew of the revolt. Add the responses that had already appeared at Wang Bo, Dou Jiande, Sun Wanrong and Song Zixian, and the great disorder of the late Sui took shape. The uprising of Du Fuwei was one of the earliest and most effective of that flood.
impact: 這場起義的第一重影響在江淮。隋朝在淮南與江南的秩序被義軍切斷，江都、丹陽、歷陽一線的城防與漕運要道相繼脫離中央控制，楊侗在洛陽的朝廷只能靠封爵與虛名把地方武人拉住，大業十四年封杜伏威為楚王正是這一手。杜伏威轉而歸唐，則使江淮這塊當時兵員、糧秣與船隻都最厚實的地區，比中原多數地區更早歸入李淵的版圖；唐軍此後平定江南、經營東南所倚賴的行政與軍隊框架，很大程度上是杜伏威及其部眾帶去的。第二重影響在制度：杜伏威以一個出身盜匪的草莽首領，卻能靠軍紀、減賦與分賞維持一支大軍十三年，說明隋末的軍隊早已變成地方勢力的私人所有；武德六年輔公祏偽稱奉杜伏威之命起兵反唐，兵敗被殺，正是這種格局的反噬，也為唐代削平地方軍頭提供了反面教材。
impactEn: The first effect of this revolt was felt in the Huai region. Sui order in the Huai valley and the lower Yangtze was cut through by the rebels, and the walled towns and transport routes of the Jiangdu, Danyang and Liyang line fell away from central control one after another; the court at Luoyang under Yang Tong could hold local military men only by bestowing titles and empty prestige, which is exactly what the grant of the title Prince of Chu to Du Fuwei in 618 was meant to do. Du Fuwei's turn to the Tang meant that the region of the Huai and Yangtze, which then had the deepest resources in soldiers, grain and boats, was folded into Li Yuan's territory earlier than most of the central plain; the administrative and military framework that the Tang later used to settle Jiangnan and to govern the southeast owed much to Du Fuwei and the men he brought with him. The second effect was institutional. A grass-roots leader who had begun as a bandit managed to hold an army of some standing for thirteen years through discipline, reduced taxes and an even share of the spoils, which shows how far the armies of the late Sui had become the private possession of local powers; when Fu Gongshi claimed in 623 to have risen in arms on Du Fuwei's order and was defeated and killed, the same arrangement turned against itself, and the episode became a cautionary case for the Tang as it began reducing local military commanders.
result: 以613年的起點論，杜伏威起義是隋末諸役中最見成效的一支：起義沒有被撲滅，隊伍由山東流竄到淮南，收併同類武裝，最後在江都與丹陽之間建立了一個能自給自足的軍政核心，並且幾乎完整地保留了實力投歸新朝。但它終究沒有變成一個獨立的王朝。杜伏威接受唐朝的吳王封號，接受行臺尚書令與上柱國的官銜，也接受入朝宿衛、交出兵權的安排，結果是武德六年輔公祏的兵變迅速失敗，淮南的軍眾與城池被朝廷逐步收編，義軍獨立的政治空間隨杜伏威之死而消失。杜伏威死於憂懼，虛歲四十一，身死之後一度被追奪名位、家眷遭籍沒，直到貞觀五年才以國公禮安葬。今日的判斷是：這場起義在軍事上極為成功，在政治上卻以交出自主權換取了延續，最終成了唐朝整合江淮的一條通道。
resultEn: Judged from the starting point of 613, the uprising of Du Fuwei was the most successful of the Sui risings: it was not put down, the force moved from Shandong into the Huai region, absorbed armed groups of the same kind, and finally built between Jiangdu and Danyang a military and political core that could supply itself, and it preserved almost its entire strength in handing over to the new dynasty. In the end, however, it did not become an independent state. Du Fuwei took the Tang title of Prince of Wu, took office as Commissioner of the Southeastern Circuit and as a general of the highest rank, and also accepted the arrangement of being summoned to the capital and giving up the command of his troops. The consequence was that Fu Gongshi's rising of 623 failed quickly, the soldiers and cities of the Huai were absorbed step by step by the court, and the independent political space of the rebels disappeared with Du Fuwei's death. Du Fuwei died of anxiety at the age of forty-one by East Asian reckoning; his titles were at first stripped and his household was subjected to confiscation, and only in 631 was he buried with the honours of a national duke. The judgement today is that this revolt was a great success militarily, and that politically it exchanged its own autonomy for survival, and in the end it became the channel through which the Tang absorbed the Huai region.
